attchmntText: Peninsula Land Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Peninsula Land Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 697 lakhs for the quarter ended September 2026, compared to a loss of 1,817 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the profit after tax was 92 lakhs, versus a loss of 2,398 lakhs in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 7,214 lakhs for the quarter and 9,484 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.21 for the quarter and 0.03 for the half year. The statutory auditor, S R B C & CO LLP, issued a review report stating no material misstatements were identified. The results are disseminated on the company website.
